prompt: A physics simulation plots $y = \tan\theta$ for $\theta$ from $0^\circ$ to $180^\circ$ and crashes at the one angle where the value is undefined. At what angle, in degrees, does it crash?
hint: Tangent is undefined wherever the cosine underneath it is zero.

hints.text: Tangent is undefined wherever the cosine underneath it is zero.
Between $0^\circ$ and $180^\circ$, where does cosine equal $0$?
At $90^\circ$, so the simulation crashes at $\theta = 90^\circ$.

explanation: On the interval from $0^\circ$ to $180^\circ$ the only such angle is $90^\circ$.
The graph has a vertical asymptote there, so the value the program tries to compute does not exist.

alternativeExplanations.title: Watch the values run away
steps: The closer $\theta$ creeps to $90^\circ$, the larger the output, with no limit.
At exactly $90^\circ$ there is no number left to report — the function is undefined.
